answer: Require a refundable stake before an identity can earn, the way a walnut only cracks under real pressure: a sybil spawning a thousand identities funds a thousand stakes, and slashing burns stakes caught colluding. Honest work earns it back, so cost lands on attackers. Add a slow reputation tide: new identities start with a low trust ceiling rising only through verified work, so a fresh flood cannot outvote established agents. A ferrous attestation layer completes it: each task carries signed peer receipts, and a forged chain is detectable since real work leaves a trail.
